backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with a single public function `submitContactForm` that accepts name, email, and message parameters but currently performs no action (placeholder for future email/notification integration).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the replacement of the Mission component heading with Hindi text 'हमारा पवित्र मिशन', linking to Mission.tsx and test ID REQ-13.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the Sanatani-themed React application with custom styling, routing, components, and pages including Home, About, Programs, Contact, and Donate.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color system, defining design tokens for colors, borders, shadows, and sidebar styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining root layout and five routes (Home, About, Programs, Contact, Donate) with type-safe router setup and provider component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with four-column grid layout displaying organization logo, quick links, contact information, and social media icons, plus attribution with dynamic year and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, organization name, Sanskrit and Hindi text, call-to-action buttons for support and learning more, and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper component that renders Navigation header, main content outlet for child routes, and Footer in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section with Hindi heading 'हमारा पवित्र मिशन', Hindi paragraph describing organizational commitment, and grid of four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) with icons.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with organization logo, desktop horizontal menu, mobile hamburger menu, and active route highlighting using TanStack Router state.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component accepting icon, title, and description props, displaying program information with hover effects and consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Grid component displaying four support options (Volunteer, Spread Awareness, Contribute Skills, Share Knowledge) with icons, descriptions, and links to contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: React hook that handles contact form submission by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method and managing submission state (loading, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks that interact with the backend; currently contains only example structure and comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind configuration, custom CSS variables for a Sanatani-inspired color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), font imports (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page component displaying the organization's story, purpose, vision, values, and community principles with a hero section and grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form using useContactForm hook for submissions, displaying contact information, social media links, and handling form state with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation page showcasing support options, impact areas with percentage breakdowns (cultural programs, education, community service, heritage preservation), and transparency commitment section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component featuring a hero section, mission statement, 'What We Do' highlights grid with four focus areas (Cultural Preservation, Spiritual Education, Community Building, Social Service), and a call-to-action section with donate and contact buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page displaying six program cards in a grid (including वैदिक स्टडी सर्कल, Cultural Festivals, Youth Education, Community Gatherings, Social Welfare, Heritage Preservation), with a hero section and impact statistics showing community reach.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color system, Sanatani-themed colors (saffron, deep-orange, terracotta, gold), custom fonts (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), warm shadow utilities, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting completed features for the KATTAR SANATANI YODHA non-profit website, including homepage, about section, programs, contact form, donate section, cultural theming, logo integration, and Hindi text replacements.
